# descope_company_google_cloud_logging_connector (Resource)

Manages a company-level Google Cloud Logging connector that streams the audit events of the whole company. It requires a company management key, and a company can have only one company-level connector.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A custom name for your connector.
- `service_account_key` (String, Sensitive) A Service Account Key JSON file created from a service account on your Google Cloud project. This file is used to authenticate and authorize the connector to access Google Cloud Logging. The service account this key belongs to must have the appropriate permissions to write logs.

### Optional

- `audit_enabled` (Boolean) Whether to enable streaming of audit events.
- `description` (String) A description of what your connector is used for.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the connector is disabled. This can be used to temporarily stop a connector from executing without fully deleting it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
